one_line: Precision brass bushing with m6 outer diameter and H7 bore
function: This part acts as a sleeve bearing or guide bushing to support relative motion between mechanical components. The radial hole enables oil lubrication or retention pin insertion.

features.value: Diameter 2.5 mm, depth 3.5 mm at 12.5 mm position

features.evidence: Drawing text C0.5 and general note 1

manufacturing: Machined from free-cutting brass material C3604 as specified in the title block.
Outer diameter m6 and bore diameter H7 demand precise turning or reaming.
Unspecified general dimensions must satisfy KS B ISO 2768-m.
